Each card is conditional on actual occurrence; this file supplies no generic factor, lifetime, range or quantity.
Generic motor gasoline does not establish grade/formulation/density/heating value or provider scope; actual supply records remain mandatory.
R134a product identity applies to actual compatible pure supplied refrigerant, not an oily mixture, gas blend, atmospheric release or assumed recharge-equals-leakage balance.
